Area.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/11] A semi-structured interview method was used, in which the respondents were asked to narrate their experiences of the sequence of events after the suicide attempt and during the hospitalization. The respondents' narratives were followed up by questions from an interview guide concerning events as well as feelings, thoughts, and reactions. The respondents were also asked about specific aspects of the care, which the interviewers considered relevant. [/page/2/Text/12] interviewers were admission to the hospital, respondents having their belongings searched by the personnel and the respondents' interaction with other patients. During the entire interview, respondents were asked to talk about their interaction experiences with the personnel.
